judgment_calls.topic: Possible diagnoses from the identification section
judgment_calls.decision: Encoded 'may have substance misuse, stress, depression/anxiety or burnout' as five possible rules (Stress at work, Harmful pattern of substance use, Depressive disorder, Anxiety disorder, Physical AND emotional exhaustion state), each on any of the identification signs.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Not encoding them (the page is addressed to health workers, which the language cannot express); gating them on Stress at work.

judgment_calls.decision: Both tasks are anchored on Stress at work (finding); the urgent task also fires on a possible diagnosis of Stress at work.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Stress (finding); no anchor exists in common symptoms or warning signs.

judgment_calls.decision: Urgent, as the box says 'Arrange urgent assessment'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Very urgent for suicidal plans; the page does not escalate.

judgment_calls.decision: Dropped: the language has no work-setting qualifier.
